rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for routes, travel, and activities over a great distance.

example.english: This is a long-distance bus route that goes to Guangzhou.
example.traditional: 呢班車係長途線，去到廣州㗎。
example.jyutping: ni1 baan1 ce1 hai6 coeng4 tou4 sin3 heoi3 dou3 gwong2 zau1 gaa3

rows.note: Use this for a romantic relationship in which the two partners live far apart.

example.english: A long-distance relationship is really hard to maintain, but we video-chat every day.
example.traditional: 異地戀真係唔易維持，但我哋會每日視像傾偈。
example.jyutping: ji6 dei6 lyun2 zan1 hai6 m4 ji6 wai4 ci4 daan6 ngo5 dei6 wui6 mui5 jat6 si6 zoeng6 king1 gai2

rows.note: Use this specifically for a nonlocal or toll telephone call, rather than for distance generally.

example.english: I made a long-distance call to my older brother in Canada last night.
example.traditional: 我噚晚打咗個長途電話畀住喺加拿大嘅阿哥。
example.jyutping: ngo5 cam4 maan5 daa2 zo2 go3 coeng4 tou4 din6 waa2 bei2 zyu6 hai2 gaa1 naa4 daai6 ge3 aa3 go1
